name: Handstand Walk
instructions: Kick up into a freestanding handstand with a tight, slightly hollow body line.
Shift weight onto one hand while the other hand's fingers press to steer.
Take small, controlled steps forward hand over hand, keeping the hips stacked over the shoulders.
Use the fingers, not the wrist, to make fine balance corrections.
Exit by stepping down or cartwheeling out when balance is lost.
